title: One git hook blocked a fake GitHub token, so no secret hit history #Shorts
first_line: One gitleaks pre-commit hook blocked a fake GitHub token commit, so no secrets reached git history.
portability: Same technique with the pre-commit framework instead of .githooks, or Husky in other JavaScript repos, running gitleaks in either.

title: Claude Code invented one endpoint shape. A 3-line rule fixed it #Shorts
first_line: Claude Code invented one endpoint shape without a rule; a three-line CLAUDE.md rule made it ask first and write zero lines.
portability: Put the same three lines in AGENTS.md for Codex-style agents or in .cursorrules for Cursor instead of CLAUDE.md.

title: I don't trust an agent's restart. I trust a counter going up by one #Shorts
first_line: A fake server restart is caught by a counter that must go up by exactly one.
portability: Same technique with a Flask app and pytest instead of Express and a shell script, or a Go service and go test instead of node.

title: My subagent stopped halfway. One missing path was why #Shorts
first_line: My subagent stopped halfway because the test file sat outside its path scope.
portability: Same brief template, pytest instead of node --test, and a scoped Cursor rules file instead of a Claude subagent.

title: I let Claude Code test my Express API, then ran it myself three times
first_line: Watch one prompt take an untested Express API from zero tests to a passing node:test suite, with test count, failures and duration_ms on screen.
portability: Same technique on another stack: pytest instead of node --test, and go test with Go's testing package, both driven by the written contract and a no-weakening rule.
